entries.source: A female Human with twisted sigils scored into her naked flesh. Her wrists and ankles are sore and hurt by ropes and chains. You can discern great beauty beyond the stains of blood covering her skin.
entries.target: 一位人类女子，赤裸的肌肤上刻满了扭曲的符文。她的手腕和脚踝被绳索与锁链勒得伤痕累累。透过皮肤上斑斑的血迹，你仍能看出她的绝美容颜。

entries.source:
The woman seems to be freed from her bonds.
She stumbles on her feet, her naked body still dripping in blood. 'Please get me out of here!'
entries.target:
这个女人似乎已摆脱了束缚。
她踉跄着站立不稳，赤裸的身体仍在滴血。“请带我离开这里！”

entries.source: Claws and teeth. Ice and death. Dragons are not all extinct it seems...
entries.target: 利爪与尖牙，寒冰与死亡。似乎龙族并没有完全灭绝……

entries.source: Claws and teeth. Fire and death. Dragons are not all extinct it seems...
entries.target: 利爪与尖牙，烈焰与死亡。似乎龙族并没有完全灭绝……

entries.source: and revived as a screeching drem bat
entries.target: 并将其复活为一只尖啸的德瑞姆蝙蝠

entries.source: #CRIMSON#%s seems invulnerable, there must be an other way to kill it!
entries.target: #CRIMSON#%s 似乎无懈可击，一定有什么其他方法可以杀死它！

entries.source: I have heard a dwarf whispering about some abomination in the deep bellow.
entries.target: 我听到有个矮人正悄悄谈论深渊咆哮里的某种憎恶。

entries.source:
This disgusting... thing crawls on the floor toward you with great speed.
It seems to come from the digestive system of the mouth.
entries.target:
这只恶心的……东西在地板上迅速的向你爬来。
它似乎是从“大嘴怪”的消化系统中出来的。

entries.source: #AQUAMARINE#With the Mouth's death its crawler also falls lifeless on the ground!
entries.target: #AQUAMARINE#当大嘴怪死去时，它的爬虫也毫无生机的倒在了地上！

entries.source: #AQUAMARINE#As #Source# falls you notice that #Target# seems to shudder in pain!
entries.target: #AQUAMARINE#当#Source#倒下时，你发现#Target#似乎因为痛苦而颤抖！

entries.source: A horrid mass of pustulent flesh, sinew, and bone; this creature seems to constantly be in pain. Two heads glare malevolently at you, an intruder in its domain.
entries.target: 一只由无数碎肉、肌腱和骨头组成的恐怖混合体，它看起来痛苦万分。它的双头恶毒的看着你，因为你闯入了它的地盘。

entries.source: A parchment falls to the floor near The Abomination.
entries.target: 一张羊皮纸掉落在了憎恶的身边。

entries.source: This portal seems to be connected with Maj'Eyal; you could probably use it to go back.
entries.target: 这个传送门似乎与马基·埃亚尔相连，你也许能通过它回去。

entries.source: Enter the portal back to Maj'Eyal? (Warning loot Draebor first)
entries.target: 进入传送门回到马基·埃亚尔？（记得先捡走德瑞宝的掉落）

entries.source: #VIOLET#You enter the swirling portal and in the blink of an eye you are back to Maj'Eyal, near the Daikara.
entries.target: #VIOLET#你进入了传送漩涡，一眨眼的功夫你已经回到了马基·埃亚尔的岱卡拉附近。

entries.source: An intensely irritating git of a monster.
entries.target: 一只令人极其讨厌的小怪物。

entries.source: As the annoying imp falls a portal appears under its corpse.
entries.target: 当这只讨厌的小恶魔被击败后，一个传送门从它的尸体下露了出来。

entries.source: Those leather boots can make anybody as annoying as their former possessor, Draebor.
entries.target: 这双靴子可以使任何人像它以前的主人小恶魔德瑞宝一样淘气。

entries.source: blink to a nearby random location within range %d (based on Magic)
entries.target: 随机传送到%d格范围内的位置（基于魔力）

entries.source: A terrifying vampiric figure of power, with flowing robes and an intense aura of fright.  His cold, sinewy flesh seems to cling to this world through greed and malice, and his eyes betray a strength of mind beyond any puny mortal.  All nearby are utterly subservient to his will, though he stands aloof from them, as if to say he needs not the pathetic meddling of minions to help him overcome his foes.  Your eyes are drawn to a dark staff in his hands which seems to suck the very life from the air around it.  It looks ancient and dangerous and terrible, and the sight of it fills you with fervent desire.
entries.target: 一个拥有强大力量的可怕吸血鬼，他的长袍无风自动，周身环绕着恐惧光环。他冰冷而精瘦的肉体似乎全凭贪婪与恶意才得以留驻人间，他的眼神透露出远超凡俗之辈的强大意志。周围所有生物都完全服从于他的意志，尽管如此，他仍对他们保持超然疏离，就好像他不需要这些废物来御敌一样。你的目光被他手里的黑色法杖吸引，这根法杖似乎在不断地吸取周围的活力。它看起来古老、危险而可怕，看到它的瞬间，你心底的欲望被彻底点燃了。

entries.source: and raised as his tortured undead thrall
entries.target: 并将其复活为他饱受折磨的不死奴仆

entries.source: It has been months since the hero cleansed the Dreadfell, yet rumours are growing: evil is back.
entries.target: 自从英雄肃清了恐惧王座后已经过去数个月了，但是仍然流传着谣言：有一股恶势力重新掌握了那里。

entries.source: A malevolent skeleton archmage that has taken control of the Dreadfell since the Master's demise.
entries.target: 一位邪恶的骷髅法师，自从领主大人死后，他便继承了恐惧王座。

entries.source:
Thick skin hangs loosely from this short, shambling form. Tufts of hair sticking out from its chin give evidence of a once magnificent dwarven beard. Half its face seems to have been seared in acid at some point, the flesh melted away from the skull and an eyeball drooping low from its socket. There is a unique sadness to its eyes, and a slump of resignation to its gait.
What proud hero of renown was this before he was condemned to such a terrible fate?
entries.target:
在你面前的是一只身形矮小、步履蹒跚的怪物，厚厚的皮肤松松垮垮地挂在身上。从它下巴伸出的一簇簇毛发，昭示着它曾经拥有过一副壮丽的矮人胡须。它的半边脸似乎曾被酸液灼烧过，血肉从头骨上融化剥落，一只眼球从眼窝中低垂下来。它的双眼中有一种独特的悲伤，步态里透着颓丧与认命。
在被判以如此可怕的命运之前，这曾是一位怎样声名远扬的骄傲英雄？

entries.source: and offered to his dark Master
entries.target: 并将其献祭给他的黑暗领主

entries.source:
What once must have been an enchantingly beautiful Higher woman now looks to be a ghost of utter despair. Her thin, elegant form ripples gently in the air, whilst her tattered robes seem oddly still. The ghost's face looks jittery and pained whilst her wild, glowing eyes move rapidly back and forth in their sockets.
Now and then she seems to see something and her jaw pulls back, her whole face splitting apart as she shrieks an unholy cry of pain and torment.
entries.target:
这位曾经想必美得摄人心魄的高等人类女子，如今看上去只是一只彻底绝望的幽灵。她瘦弱而优雅的身躯在空中轻轻荡漾，破烂的长袍却诡异地纹丝不动。她的脸上满是抽搐与痛苦，狂乱而发亮的眼睛在眼眶里飞快地来回转动。
有时她会看到一些东西，她的下巴会突然收缩，分裂的脸部会发出一阵充满痛苦和折磨的哀嚎。

entries.source: and offered to her dark Master
entries.target: 并将其献祭给她的黑暗领主

entries.source:
A short, furtive-looking skeleton with padded feet. He moves quickly and silently, and seems to meld into the shadows with ease. In one hand he holds a sling, and the other a short dagger.
There is a cunning air to his hollow skull, and his empty sockets reveal nothing of what tricks and tactics he has planned.
entries.target:
一个矮小的、鬼鬼祟祟的骷髅，它的脚上裹着软垫。他迅捷而隐蔽，并且擅长融入黑暗。一只手拿着投石索，另一只手则拿着一柄匕首。
他空洞的头骨透着一股狡黠的气息，而空荡荡的眼窝丝毫看不出他盘算着什么诡计与战术。

entries.source: A smudged poem chalked on a dark piece of slate
entries.target: 一首写在石板上的被弄脏的诗歌

entries.source: A poem written in scribbled, child-like writing
entries.target: 像小孩子写的潦草诗歌

entries.source: A poem written in an elegant Gothic script
A letter written in a bold, commanding script
entries.target: 用粗体的命令性文字写的信

entries.source: This ugly orc looks really nasty and vicious. He is obviously looking for something and bears an unknown symbol on his shield.
entries.target: 这只丑陋的兽人看起来凶恶而狠毒。他显然在寻找什么东西，盾牌上带着一个未知的徽记。

entries.source: A paper scrap, left by Ukruk.
